sample: GM12878 (= NA12878 = GIAB HG001), whole-transcriptome IVT (in-vitro-transcribed, unmodified RNA)
aligners: minimap2 + uLTRA + deSALT (3-aligner strict consensus); gapmm2 dropped (too slow on human); mapPacBio dropped (games HP-ED consensus)
trim: NO trim-polya; --exclude-3prime-bp 50 used instead (IVT poly-A ~15bp; functionally equivalent to trim for internal-HP rates; yeast used trim + (0,0) exclusion)
masking: GIAB HG001 NISTv4.2.1 small-variant VCF (3,893,341 records masked, indels expanded) + high-confidence-regions BED (restrict); usable = 2507.9 Mb of chr1-22
consensus_reads: ~8.4M reads common to all 3 aligners (minimap2 8.93M / uLTRA 8.94M / deSALT 8.65M mapped); chr1-22 only (GIAB benchmark scope)
compute: Sherlock: 45-chunk align array (96GB/task) -> per-aligner merge -> 22-chrom parallel profiler -> sum error_counts -> compute_rates+derive_penalties
caveats: IVT (unmodified) -> avoids A-to-I-editing inflation of the AT substitution anchor, but lacks modification-induced miscalls present in NATIVE Sumner RNA
wholeIVT carries a T7/RT error signature
